summary: Keep native suggestions stable and skip ineffective optional reranking

changes.title: Isolate parallel dictionary work
changes.detail: Keep locale decoder weight state independent and hold dictionary lifetimes stable until active native suggestion queries finish. Recoverable failures leave the remaining native suggestions available.

changes.title: Avoid redundant language lookups
changes.detail: Reuse each active dictionary group's word-validity results when updating multilingual confidence.

changes.title: Skip optional model work when order cannot change
changes.detail: When the experimental ContextLM is explicitly enabled, skip context encoding and candidate scoring unless an eligible adjacent native near-tie can legally move under the existing ranking policy. The native order and disabled-by-default setting remain unchanged.
